Review Text: The Dal Makhani and Garlic Naan were extraordinary! Melt-in-mouth texture and superb dining ambience.
Disastrous packaging! Dal and butter chicken gravy leaked all over the paper bag. The container lid was broken.
Raita and mint chutney were completely missing from the Mutton Biryani combo. Third time this has happened.
Loved the paneer tikka and mocktails. Service was attentive, though main course took 25 minutes to arrive.
Khana bilkul thanda tha aur delivery 50 minute late aayi. Roti itni rubbery thi ki khayi nahi gayi.
Flawless family dinner! The chef personally checked on our table. Crispy stuffed kulchas and aromatic tea.
Portion size of Kadhai Paneer has shrunk significantly while prices increased. Charged 480 rupees for 4 small cubes.
Both soup bowls spilled inside the polybag because lids had no tape sealing. Food quality was ruined.
Best Butter Chicken in Delhi! Perfectly balanced creamy gravy, smoky tandoori chicken, and prompt service.
Found a long hair inside the Chicken Tikka Masala. Extremely unhygienic kitchen standards. Manager was unhelpful.
Rich and flavorful Rogan Josh. Gulab Jamun was served hot and delicious. Will definitely visit again.
Taste was decent but packaging was messy with oil stains everywhere on the paper box.
Celebrated my birthday here. The team surprised us with a complimentary dessert and wonderful hospitality.
Waiter forgot our beverage order and bill had extra charge for mineral water we never asked for.
Top-notch authentic North Indian cuisine. The Biryani aroma was sensational. Highly recommended!
